title: Jawan Ali Akbar
body:
raahat e jaan wird e zaban
saa'at e azan jaan ali akbaram
<<DIVIDER>>
jawan ali akbar naujawan ali akbar
ay gul e laila ali jaan ali akbaram
jawan ali akbar naujawan ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
ay dil o jaan e pidar shakle payambar akbar
ay qaraar e dil e zainab gul e maadar akbar
misle abbas e jari shere dilawar akbar
yusuf e fatema zahra dil e hyder akbar
husn e zaman akbar ay naaz e chaman akbar
ay gul e laila...
jawan ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
maula shabir ne maanga hai duaon mein tumhe
ghazi abbas ne rakha hai panaaho mein tumhe
mil ke do maaon ne paala hai ridaon mein tumhe
rabb e akbar ne rakha noori hijabon mein tumhe
naaz e dil e sarwar ay shabih e paighambar
<<DIVIDER>>
boli laila ke galay mujhko lagate jao
boli zainab mujhe surat to dikhate jao
bole shabbir meri aas bandhate jao
mujhko nana ki ziyarat to karate jao
haye lahoo mein tar humsurat e paighambar
ay gul e laila...
jawan ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise maqtal tumhe jaane ki ijazat de doo
kaise qaime se nikalne ki ijazat de doo
kaise is pyaas mein ladne ki ijazat de doo
maa hoo kaise tumhe marne ki ijazat de doo
ay jaan e dil e maadar ye maa ho fida tum par
ay gul e laila...
jawan ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaake seene pe sina zeen se akbar jo gira
ho gaya qaimon mein kohraam bapa wawaila
ye sada dasht mein deta tha ghareeb e zahra
haye akbar mera akbar mera akbar na raha
noor e nazar akbar ay naaz e pidar akbar
ay gul e laila...
jawan ali akbar...
author: N. Sarwar & J. Jaffri
